Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging

Interface ReleaseChangeEventPublisher

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    ReleaseChangeEventPublisherImpl
    public interface ReleaseChangeEventPublisher
    Service that distributes ReleaseChangeEvents among the ReleaseChangeEventListeners. It basically aggregates all ReleaseChangeEventListeners.

      • getStagePath

        @Nullable
@Nullable String getStagePath​(@Nullable
                              @Nullable org.apache.sling.api.resource.Resource releaseRoot,
                              @Nullable
                              @Nullable String stage)
        Determines the path at which a release is replicated. This is the target path for the replication configuration which contains the site root and replicates the given stage. If this doesn't give an unique result, null is returned.

      • abortReplication

        void abortReplication​(@Nullable
                      @Nullable org.apache.sling.api.resource.Resource releaseRoot,
                      @Nullable
                      @Nullable String stage)
        Stops each running or faulty replication process - reset and clear for a new synchronization.
        Parameters:
        releaseRoot - the root of a release - if null we return an empty map.
        stage - if set, this filters the result after ReleaseChangeProcess.getStage().

      • compareTree

        void compareTree​(@NotNull
                 @NotNull com.composum.sling.core.ResourceHandle resource,
                 int details,
                 @Nullable
                 @Nullable String[] processIdParams,
                 @NotNull
                 @NotNull Map<String,​? super ReleaseChangeEventPublisher.CompareResult> output)
          throws ReplicationException
        Compares the contents of the whole release root or subtree at {resource}.
        Parameters:
        resource - a release root or a subnode of it
        details - If 0, only difference counts are returned. If 1, the different paths are included. For some replication types higher values switch on further checks.
        processIdParams - if set, comparisons are only done for the ReleaseChangeProcess with the given ReleaseChangeProcess.getId().
        output - the result is added here: the ReleaseChangeProcess.getId() is mapped to the corresponding ReleaseChangeEventPublisher.CompareResult.
        Throws:
        ReplicationException
